bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-applicant-balanced-6178467 --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 73
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 74
git -C "$r" show 23c19b89c64241919bfde7b8e881ac98e1328c70:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 75
rooms=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE title='【検証】ROOMボタン配置実機テスト' AND created_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '14 days'")
test "$rooms" = 0 || { echo ROOM_LAYOUT_TEST_PREVIOUS_POST_PRESENT_NO_RETRY; exit 76; }
drafts=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND data->>'title'='【検証】ROOMボタン配置実機テスト'")
test "$drafts" = 0 || { echo ROOM_LAYOUT_TEST_PREVIOUS_DRAFT_PRESENT_NO_RETRY; exit 77; }
if "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_public_post_smoke; then result=PASS; else result=FAIL; fi
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 79
echo ROOM_LAYOUT_USERBOT_LIVE_FINISH_E2E="$result"
test "$result" = PASS || exit 80
echo ROOM_LAYOUT_TELEGRAM_DM_ROWS_VERIFIED=PASS
